busy50_batches: B1 and largest successfully measured ascending batch; if same, only once
same_model_process: Load each model once; ascend B1,2,3,... without reload or empty_cache between successful batches
cost_boundary: Resident complete service window, including all imposed waiting; NOT first200 dataset-once inference latency
quality: Only repeated firstB native outputs checked; no new full558 SRCC inferred
on_capacity_failure: Record failure, stop increasing this model; no backend/precision/graph changes or repeated failed batch
